Check Multi-Structure Covariance Convergence and Sensitivity Diagnostics

Source: R/check_multicov.R
check_multicov.Rd

Evaluates structure sampling, within-structure MCMC convergence, within-group structure sensitivity, and between-group divergence (Rhat_group / Rhat_backbone), alongside an exact Law of Total Variance decomposition partitioning posterior parameter uncertainty (total \(\text{SD}^2\)) into within-tree estimation uncertainty (unexplained biological variance / sample size), within-group structure variation, and between-group hypothesis variation for any because model fitted with a collection or ensemble of covariance structures (e.g., phylogenetic trees/backbones, spatial distance kernels, genomic relationship matrices, or network graphs).

Usage

check_multicov(model, plot = TRUE, show_internal = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

model

A because model object fitted with multiple candidate covariance structures.

plot

Logical. If TRUE (default), displays a publication-ready 2-panel diagnostic figure featuring hypothesis sensitivity forest plot (left) and 100% stacked uncertainty variance decomposition (right).

show_internal

Logical. If FALSE (default), suppresses internal additive simulation noise parameters (e.g. sigma_Brain, sigma_shared_*) for pure latent indicator variables in marginalized latent (MAG) models.

...

Additional arguments passed to plotting functions or metadata overrides (e.g., group = c(...) to override group/backbone labels).

Value

An invisible object of class check_multicov containing:

param_diagnostics

Data frame of parameter sensitivity \(\widehat{R}\) across candidate structures/trees, groups/backbones, and overall ensemble omnibus \(\widehat{R}_{\text{all}}\).

variance_decomposition

Exact Law of Total Variance table decomposing total parameter posterior variance (\(\text{SD}^2\)) into within-structure estimation uncertainty, between-structure variation, and between-group hypothesis variation.

rhat_per_tree

Matrix of within-structure MCMC \(\widehat{R}\) values for each parameter on each candidate tree/structure. Kept unprinted by default to avoid console clutter, but directly indexable on demand.

structure_weights_pct

Posterior weights per candidate structure/tree.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Fit with multiple candidate covariance structures (e.g. multiPhylo ensemble)
fit <- because(list(y ~ x), data = my_data, structure = my_cov_list, engine = "numpyro")
chk <- check_multicov(fit)

# Inspect within-tree MCMC convergence for specific parameters or trees on demand:
chk$rhat_per_tree["beta_y_x", ]   # Within-tree Rhat across all candidate trees for beta_y_x
chk$rhat_per_tree[, "Tree_1"]     # Within-tree Rhat for all parameters on Tree 1
} # }
